component_structure.tagline: AI Vision Appraisal & Elevated Second-Hand Pricing for Charity Shops

key_components.name: PasscodeGateModal
key_components.purpose: Shared single shop passcode lockscreen (e.g. 'FIND2026' or 'CHARITY123') with quick numpad, remember-session toggle, and smooth unlock reveal

key_components.name: DualCaptureUploader
key_components.purpose: Mobile-optimized dual-slot image uploader: Slot 1 (Item overview photo) + Slot 2 (Brand tag / hallmark / label photo) with sample preset buttons for rapid testing

key_components.name: AppraisalResultCard
key_components.purpose: Cinematic appraisal dossier showing item recognition, brand identification, condition rating, peak historical retail price, second-hand market average, and the highlighted elevated charity price (+15% formula) with breakdown explanation

key_components.name: PrintablePriceTag
key_components.purpose: Printable charity tag generator featuring rendered Barcode (SVG Code128 / standard format), live QR Code (linking to public verification/story page), item title, SKU/ID, donor impact note, and prominent price

key_components.name: InventoryLedger
key_components.purpose: Full charity inventory table with quick search, category filters, total elevated funds generated metric, export option, and tag reprint triggers

key_components.name: AppHeader
key_components.purpose: Obsidian crystal header with 'One Of A Find' luxury badge, shop branch indicator, online status, passcode lock toggle, and navigation tabs

instructions_to_main_agent: Use deep obsidian dark theme (#0B0C0E) with charcoal surface panels (#16181C) and warm luminous gold highlights (#D9B48F). Ensure 1px subtle gold borders and glow effects.
Implement the single shared password for the charity shop (default e.g. 'CHARITY2026' or 'VINTAGE2026') stored in localStorage/session so volunteers can work seamlessly.

Dual photo capture: Allow uploading or taking photo of item + photo of brand label. Provide pre-seeded sample buttons (e.g. 'Vintage Barbour Jacket', 'Omega Seamaster', 'Mulberry Handbag', 'Burberry Trench') for instant one-click appraisal simulation.

AI Appraisal calculation: Calculate Peak Retail Price (£), Second-Hand Market Average (£), and Elevated Charity Price = Market Average * 1.15 (+15% uplift). Show the charity gain (£ extra raised for the cause).

Generate genuine working Barcode and QR Code on the printable tag (use jsbarcode or svg barcode representation, and qrcode.react / svg QR generator) so tags look authentic and are printable via window.print() or download as tag.
Support United Kingdom locale formatting: £ currency symbol, British date formats (DD/MM/YYYY), and volunteer-friendly language.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, passcode field, tab, tag print button, and metric card.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.aesthetic: Obsidian dark luxury appraisal, razor-sharp typography, warm gold accents, non-generic layout, tactile card depths with 1px border glows
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.performance: Instant client responsiveness with optimistic UI updates and robust fallback sample appraisals for offline CDN preview resilience
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All elements equipped with data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='passcode-input', data-testid='appraise-btn', data-testid='print-tag-btn')
